findings.failureScenario: The --connect comment in mcp() says a non-address token such as a command id 'leaves the address at its default so the command is still consumed next', but mcp has no command tokens: such a token becomes a FILE and immediately fails with 'FILES, --demo and --library apply to headless mode only'. The comment was copied from run(), whose filter also differs (run rejects tokens containing '='), so the two parsers are documented as identical while behaving differently.
findings.action: Rewrite the mcp comment to state that a non-address token is treated as a file (and rejected in connect mode), or share one connect-argument parser between run and mcp.

findings.failureScenario: After a GPU startup crash the user-facing notice says to re-enable 'Settings > Performance > Use the GPU for rendering' and to try LIGHTCRAFT_GPU_BACKEND=dx12, vulkan or off. The Settings checkbox is actually labelled 'Use GPU rendering when available', and on macOS (a supported host for this binary) neither dx12 nor vulkan is a usable backend; metal, which parse_backends accepts (crates/gpu/src/backend.rs:11), is not mentioned. A macOS user following the recovery instructions sets a backend that cannot initialise.
findings.action: Make the notice platform-specific (metal/off on macOS, dx12/vulkan/off on Windows) and quote the actual Settings label.
